craft_notes: Sthāyin: parokṣa-dīkṣā unit 14. Sanskrit-first kept. Rows: 4. Close: rest. Rejected: smoothing — killed: flagged. Read aloud: steady cadence.

lines: Preliminary consecration, caru, field, bed, maṇḍala-preparation are not useful here; (they are) for the disciple's purification and dream-seeing.
